description: Angular component for a value input UI, supporting various data types, layout responsiveness, and JSON editing dialog.

classes.name: ValueInputLayout
classes.description: Interface defining layout options for the value input component.

classes.name: ValueInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a flexible, type-aware input field with JSON editing and responsive layout.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes labels, layout, and subscriptions based on inputs.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially 'valueType'.

methods.name: openEditJSONDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog for editing JSON values.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers change callback for form control.

methods.name: onValueTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the value type selection.

methods.name: detectValueType
methods.description: Infers the value type from the current model value.

methods.name: updateModelToValueType
methods.description: Converts the model value to match the selected value type.

methods.name: _computeLayout
methods.description: Determines the layout based on static setting or breakpoints.
